Name: Yet Another Map Teleport
Author: Moddem
Description:
Yet another simple mod for fast trevel to labeled locations on the map.

[b][u]!WARNING! MOD COMES WITH NO LOCATION WARP CONFIG, SO YOU NEED TO CONFIGURE IT BY FOLLOWING STEPS BELOW![/u][/b]

[b]Mod Configuration filte[/b] is on mod folder, generated after first game initialization - you can customize input keys(currently set to left mouse click, "X" gamepad and possible for touch(not checked))(multiple keys supported by separatting with ",")

[b]Coordinates config[/b] will generate only after first point will be saved. You can configure your own points/positions, but you need some time following this steps (share it somewhere, if you want to contribute to community :) ):

[list=1]
[*]Open the map and click on location
[*]If its first time when you click on this location it will be added to the config
[*]Go to this location or if you are already there then you are good to go to step 4. [i][size=1]or you can go to any location and save this labeled location to any other porposes :)[/size][/i]
[*][size=3]You would get a popup notification, do what you need. "Save", "Override" or "Cancel" to save later.[/size]
[size=3]
//DEPRECATED
[/size]
[*]Then open SMAPI console and write [b]maptp_save "LABALED LOCATION NAME"[/b] if you want to save specific to current position OR [b]maptp_saveLas[/b]t if you want to save [b]last config added location[/b]
//-----------------------


[*][b]Your current position wiil be saved as warp point.[/b]

[/list][b]
[/b]SMAPI Console avaible commands (write - help [u]commandName[/u] for more information):

[list]
[*][u]maptp_lis[/u]t <id> (id: 0/1/2)
[*][u]maptp_save[/u] <labeled name>
[*][u]maptp_saveLast[/u]
[/list]
